title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The Plan International Ireland SQRIBE programme is located across seven locations across Guinea, Guinea-Bissau, Burkina Faso, Mali, Central African Republic, and Cameroon. The intended outcome is that Vulnerable and Marginalised Children Realise their Rights to Access and Benefit from a Safe, Quality, Resilient and Inclusion-Based Education (SQRIBE). The objective of the grant is to meet [urgent] education and protection needs for children. The key activities include financial and technical support to schools and vocational centres, community sensitisation and mobilisation in relation to child rights, in particular girls’ rights, and capacity building for education stakeholders. The programme is delivered in partnership with local partners.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome 4 Inclusive and transformative education systems change in policies and practices and are better prepared to respond to and mitigate the risks of disasters, conflict and violence.. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: Gender equality is marked as 2 because the programme has gender equality as a principal objective, ensuring that safe, quality, resilient, and inclusive education explicitly addresses gender disparities and promotes transformative change. Inclusion and empowerment of persons with disabilities is also marked as 2 in the LTD projects because it is an equally significant objective, with targeted interventions and results demonstrating a strong commitment to ensuring the full participation and empowerment of children with disabilities within the education system
